questions.question: The car-wash takings of R2 400 are shared in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2. What is the value of ONE part?
A recipe uses 250 g of butter to 1 kg of flour. Written in simplest form, the ratio butter : flour is:
A concrete mix uses cement : sand : stone in the ratio 1 : 3 : 5. For 27 wheelbarrows of mix, how many wheelbarrows of stone are needed?
Which statement about ratios is correct?
options: A ratio always carries a unit such as rand or kilogram
The order of the numbers in a ratio may be swapped without changing the meaning
A ratio compares quantities of the same kind, in the same unit, and carries no unit itself
A ratio can only compare two quantities, never three

subtopics.title: Rate — A Comparison That Carries Its Units

questions.question: A bakkie travels 480 km on 40 litres of petrol. What is its fuel consumption?
The same bakkie is driven 300 km. At R23,40 per litre, what does the petrol for the trip cost?
A taxi covers 63 km in 45 minutes. What is its average speed in km/h?
Water is charged at R14,50 per kilolitre. What does a household that uses 18 kℓ pay?
Six loaves cost R114,00. Using the unitary method, what do 11 loaves cost?
Four painters take 15 days to paint a school block. How many days would 6 painters take, working at the same rate?
Which test confirms that two quantities are in INDIRECT proportion?
options: Dividing one by the other always gives the same constant
Multiplying the pair always gives the same constant
Adding the pair always gives the same constant
Subtracting one from the other always gives zero

questions.question: A bus costs a fixed R900 to hire. If 20 learners travel instead of 15, what happens to the cost per learner?
options: It rises from R45,00 to R60,00
It stays at R60,00 because the bus price is fixed
It falls from R60,00 to R45,00
It falls from R60,00 to R30,00

subtopics.title: Best Buy — Making the Comparison Fair

questions.question: A 2,5 kg bag of maize meal costs R42,99. What is the price per kilogram, rounded to the nearest cent?
The 10 kg bag costs R159,99. Which bag is the better buy, and by roughly how much per kilogram?
options: The 2,5 kg bag, by about R1,20 per kg
The 10 kg bag, by about R1,20 per kg
The 10 kg bag, by about R12,00 per kg
Neither — the price per kilogram is the same

questions.question: Which habit does the lesson name as the one that most often costs marks in a best-buy question?
options: Writing the answer as a full sentence
Showing the substitution on the page
Rounding part-way through instead of only at the end

questions.question: Why might a shopper still choose the 2,5 kg bag even though it costs more per kilogram?
options: Because the price per kilogram is not a fair comparison
Because she may not have the larger amount of cash available, or may lack dry storage
Because smaller bags always contain better-quality meal
Because the ratio of the two prices is 1 : 4

questions.question: In the loaf analogy, what must you do FIRST before handing out any shares?
options: Give the biggest share to whoever worked hardest
Cut the loaf into the total number of parts

questions.question: Sharing R2 400 in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2, the middle share is:
Which check does the Simplifier recommend at the end of every sharing question?
options: Divide the largest share by the smallest
Add the shares back up and confirm they equal the original amount
Round each share to the nearest R100

subtopics.title: What One Costs, What One Does

questions.question: In a rate, the word "per" means:
A bakkie does 12 km per litre. How much petrol does a 300 km trip need?
Why can you not simply divide 63 km by 45 to get the taxi's speed in km/h?
options: Because speed must always be rounded to the nearest ten
Because 45 is in minutes, and an answer in km/h needs the time in hours
Because distance must be converted to metres first

questions.question: What is the general rule the Simplifier gives for tariff-style costs?
options: Price of one, times how many
Total price, divided by the rate
Price of one, plus how many
How many, divided by the price of one

subtopics.title: More Hands, Fewer Days — and Finding the Real Price

questions.question: Four painters take 15 days. How does the Simplifier describe the size of the job?
A R900 bus hire shared among 15 learners costs each of them:
Comparing a 2,5 kg bag at R42,99 with a 10 kg bag at R159,99, the fair comparison is:
options: the two shelf prices side by side
the price of one kilogram in each case
the mass difference between the bags

questions.question: Which final answer would a marker reward most fully?
options: "The 10 kg bag is the better buy at R16,00 per kg compared with R17,20 per kg, provided the shopper can afford R159,99 and store it dry."
